claim_text: All six stops on the North Loop tram route had reopened by 14:10.

evidence_spans.snippet_text: Transit staff said two of the route's six stops remained closed while crews cleared debris.

source_webpage.html_content: Service resumed on the North Loop tram route at 14:10. Transit staff said two of the route's six stops remained closed while crews cleared debris.

verdict_rationale: The webpage states that two of the six stops remained closed, directly contradicting the claim that all six had reopened by 14:10.
